title: Request for Comments Reference Guide
summary: A historical account that categorizes and summarizes RFCs 1 through 999, issued between 1969 and 1987. It cross-references them to show which are current, obsolete or revised. It replaces RFC 999.

eli5.summary: It is a guide to the first thousand memos of the Internet, like a table of contents that also tells you which ones are outdated.

questions: what is the rfc reference guide
where to find a summary of rfc 1 to 999
